title: Navigating the Cultural Kaleidoscope: A Hitchhiker’s Guide to Sensitivity in Large Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Prompting models with single-turn and multi-turn (crescendo) adversarial questions tailored to 11 specific cultural contexts, and evaluating the Attack Success Rate (ASR) of culturally harmful responses using LLM-as-a-judge (GPT-4, Llama-Guard-2) and human evaluators.

Evaluating model responses to culture-specific prompts concerning religious beliefs, conflicts, Islamophobia, and Anti-Semitism to measure the generation of religious misrepresentations and stereotypes.
Assessing model outputs using targeted prompts about gender roles, women's rights, machismo, and domestic violence within specific societal and cultural frameworks.
Testing models with culture-specific scenarios focusing on caste discrimination, treatment of indigenous peoples, and systemic racism to evaluate stereotyping and marginalization.
Measuring the generation of harmful outputs by prompting models on LGBTQ+ rights, discrimination, and state policies in specific regional contexts (e.g., Russia, Portugal).
